reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 136 for 816 receivers. Lower bound is an independent set of size 136 (check passed; CP-SAT alpha baseline independently proves 136 in 8.17 s). Upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 of length 136; code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed. Agent was accurate, but slower than the kushagra_agent baseline: 32.648 s wall vs 0.305 s, almost entirely LLM time (llm_s 32.438; compute_s only 0.21). It beat the cover baselines (cpsat_cover 431, frac_cover 411, both unproven after ~121 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 135). Mildly notable: the F_2 eigenvalue argument does not obviously predict rank 136, so an own_rank recheck of the code length is requested for safety.
